description: Text in an element an inline template wraps (`*ngFor`). The template's own bindings — `ngFor`, written, and `ngForOf`, bound — are inputs of the directive on the template, which draws a comment: the compiler's visitor does not hand them on (`templateAttrs`), and the walk passes over them, as it reads the text inside. A walk that left either kind unreached refuses this case on point 1 instead.
